waybackify bucket push [flags]

Emit the bucket-population batch for a cache root

Walk a cache root and emit one `s5cmd run` cp line per entry — the
cap/ half of projecting the store onto an R2 / Fastly bucket, ready
to pipe: `waybackify bucket push … | s5cmd --endpoint-url <ep> run`.
Never mutates anything, never talks to the network.

Output: the batch lines on stdout, a summary on stderr. --dry-run
writes the batch to stderr instead, so an accidental `| s5cmd run`
is a no-op.

Flags:
  --root|-r <root>      cache root (the archive of record) — required
  --bucket <name>       target bucket ('name' or 's3://name[/prefix]') — required
  --empty-file <path>   zero-byte scratch file for bodiless entries (create it OUTSIDE the root)
  --dry-run             write the batch to stderr; emit NOTHING to stdout
  --help|-h             Show help

part of the wayback mirror tooling
